definition: Some n is an actual concretum at w, has no actual concrete ground under the selected relation there, exists at each world accessible from w, and has no distinct simply-prior predecessor. No uniqueness, maximum, God identification, universal causality or other-world rootness is asserted.
note: A source-free conjunction packaging existing predicates for a conditional composition, not a new metaphysical relation. Existing firstness and no-potency source readings retain their own records. Independent sourcing would have to defend the selected grounding interpretation, simply-prior correspondence and input premises for the same actual candidates; naming this conjunction does not establish those commitments.
